Several suggestions involve `import Cslib.Init` removal, which per CONTRIBUTING.md's CI section may be a false positive (Cslib.Init sets up default linting/tactics rather than being a term-level dependency) -- these need the special shake preserve-comment (see `lake shake --help`) rather than blind removal. The remaining suggestions (GenericMCSBridge.lean x3 swapping MCSProperties->GenericMCS, Encodable.Basic move between Structures.lean/Elimination.lean, Satisfies import move between Closure.lean/Atoms.lean, etc.) are genuine import-hygiene fixes. This is scoped narrowly to files touched by the 5 vetted tasks; it does not attempt to fix the codebase-wide shake backlog (~4700 lines of output across files unrelated to these tasks).
